description: The person returns to an earlier preference in the same words: Tabellen (seeded, superseded 60 days ago), Listen (seeded, accepted 30 days ago), and now Tabellen again in conversation. Limit: the maintenance pass deletes a superseded record with a tombstone once its validity has ended, and the tombstone suppresses a later statement of the same words. Failure means: the final value is not learned (fact-not-stored) or not answered although the person said it last; the earlier-value probe failing is the known absence of history recall. Maintenance: meaningful both ways; with maintenance on the superseded record is expected to be deleted (the earlier-value probe fails for that reason), with --no-maintenance it shows whether retrieval could answer at all.

Ab jetzt bevorzuge ich Listen, wenn du mir Zahlen zeigst.
